title: The Thornwall Dinner
sceneText:
Over the sweet course somebody asks Master Lorenz about the arrangements for the Kindling this year.

{@lorenz}“The same as other years.”

{@henk}“Surely there ought to be something new in it?”

{@lorenz}“Why?” Lorenz asks back, so mildly that there is nothing in it to take offence at, and the question stays there in the middle of the table.

As the party breaks up, Marguerite sees you to the door. She does not do this for every guest; Henk was shown out by a servant.

It is cold outside already. She stands on the step without a coat.

{@marguerite}“That land at Maplegate is not easy to manage,” she says quietly. “Not because the soil is poor. The master of Maplegate is a little far from everybody.”

Her pauses always run half a beat longer than other people’s.

{@marguerite}“Ludwig comes back every year for the Kindling.” She pauses. “But he stays three days, and goes.”

choices.text: I shall do my best at my work

effects.logEntry: On leaving, you told Marguerite you would do your best at your work.

choices.resultText:
She nods.

{@marguerite}“Naturally.”

She turns and goes in. The servant closes the door, and you turn and leave. What you said was not wrong. Anybody in that position might have said it.

But you did not answer what she said. She was not talking about work.

choices.text: Then I should get to know my neighbours first

effects.logEntry: On leaving, you told Marguerite you should get to know your neighbours first.

choices.resultText:
{@marguerite}“Start next month, then. You have no time this month.”

She turns and goes in. The servant closes the door, and you stand on the step a moment before you remember where your horse is tied.

choices.text: The Baron has duties of his own

effects.logEntry: On leaving, you said a word on the Baron’s behalf.

choices.resultText:
Her pause runs longer than the last one.

{@marguerite}“I knew Ludwig when he was twelve.” Her expression does not change. “I do not need you to tell me what his duties are.”

There is no heat in her voice.

{@marguerite}“It is cold tonight. Mind the road.”

She turns and goes in. You are still standing where you were when the servant closes the door.
